checkRuns.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    if (error instanceof ActionError && error.data?.errors)
      errors.set(error.data.errors)
    else
      throw error""","""    if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
      throw error
    errors.set((error.data as { errors?: ContactErrors } | undefined)?.errors ?? {})""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30

rm tests/tmp-send.test.ts; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sleep 1
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun test 2>&1 | tail -3
PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
for p in / /books /books/moby-dick /about /contact /x; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4702$p; done
pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sleep 1; pgrep -fl "bun src/server.ts" || echo "server stopped"
pgrep -af "src/server.ts" | grep -v pgrep; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; bun test 2>&1 | tail -3

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
for f,tag in [('name','input#contact-name(type="text" name="name"'),('email','input#contact-email(type="email" name="email"'),('message','textarea#contact-message(name="message"')]:
    s=s.replace(tag+')', tag+f' aria-invalid={{errors.{f} ? \'true\' : undefined}} aria-describedby={{errors.{f} ? \'contact-{f}-error\' : undefined}})')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n aria src/components/contact-form.kay
bun add -d @happy-dom/global-registrator 2>&1 | tail -3
printf '[test]\npreload = ["kay/test/preload"]\n' > bunfig.toml
